practicals.title: Ultrasonic Distance Lab & Radar Sonar
practicals.goal: Understand ultrasonic pulse echo physics, speed-of-sound formula conversion, and threshold buzzer activation logic.
steps: Connect VCC to 5V, GND to Ground, TRIG to Digital Pin 9, and ECHO to Digital Pin 10
Send a 10-microsecond HIGH trigger pulse to initiate 40kHz acoustic transmission
Capture duration using pulseIn() and compute distance: Distance (cm) = (Duration * 0.0343) / 2
Establish near/far proximity rules to trigger a safety alert LED and buzzer alert

practicals.title: Soil Moisture & Automated Irrigation Experiment
practicals.goal: Convert analog dielectric soil measurements into automated water pump relay actuation algorithms.
steps: Insert the corrosion-resistant probe into soil and wire VCC/GND to 5V rail
Connect analog pin A0 to read raw ADC voltage values between 0 and 1023
Calibrate threshold readings: Dry Soil (>700), Optimal Moisture (400-600), Saturated (<350)
Trigger a 5V relay module to automatically actuate a micro water pump when dry

practicals.title: DHT11 Climate & Environmental Telemetry Lab
practicals.goal: Interface digital single-bus protocols to extract ambient temperature (°C) and humidity (%RH) with live LCD telemetry.
steps: Connect DHT11 signal pin to Digital Pin 2 with a 10kΩ pull-up resistor to 5V
Include DHT sensor library and initialize communication at 9600 baud rate
Extract relative humidity (%) and temperature (°C) every 2000 milliseconds
Display real-time environmental metrics on a 16x2 I2C Character LCD module

practicals.title: L298N Dual H-Bridge Motor Control & PWM Steering
practicals.goal: Master bidirectional DC motor speed regulation using Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) and H-Bridge polarity switching.
steps: Connect motor power terminal to 12V battery and logic power terminal to Arduino 5V
Connect IN1, IN2, IN3, IN4 to microcontroller digital pins and ENA/ENB to PWM pins
Set logic HIGH/LOW combinations across IN pins to control Forward, Reverse, and Pivot turns
Adjust analogWrite() PWM values (0 to 255) to modulate smooth deceleration and acceleration curves

practicals.title: MPU-6050 6-Axis Motion & Balance Lab
practicals.goal: Implement I2C register communication and complementary filtering to compute real-time Roll, Pitch, and Yaw orientation angles.
steps: Connect SDA and SCL to Arduino A4 and A5 pins (or dedicated I2C pins) with 3.3V/5V supply
Initialize MPU6050 accelerometer and gyroscope registers via I2C Wire protocol at 400kHz
Read 6-axis raw registers and apply complementary filter: Angle = 0.98 * (Angle + Gyro*dt) + 0.02 * Accel
Output live orientation angles to 0.96 inch OLED HUD display for stabilizing servo balance

practicals.title: HC-05 Bluetooth Wireless Telemetry & Smartphone Control
practicals.goal: Establish bidirectional wireless serial communication between microcontroller and mobile smartphone app.
steps: Connect HC-05 TXD to Arduino RX and HC-05 RXD to Arduino TX through a voltage divider
Pair smartphone with HC-05 module (Default PIN: 1234)
Write serial event listener in firmware to process command packets ('F', 'B', 'L', 'R')
Transmit real-time telemetry back to smartphone display terminal

practicals.title: TM1637 4-Digit Real-Time Clock & Stopwatch
practicals.goal: Drive multiplexed 7-segment digital displays using a 2-wire serial clock protocol for timing and counter systems.
steps: Connect CLK to Arduino Pin 2 and DIO to Arduino Pin 3 with 5V/GND power
Initialize TM1637 library and set display brightness to level 5
Construct millis() timer loop to increment minutes and seconds accurately
Flash the central colon dot every 1000 milliseconds to simulate digital chronometer

practicals.title: PIR Infrared Smart Corridor Lighting Controller
practicals.goal: Implement passive pyroelectric human motion sensing to actuate isolated 250V AC relay circuits with auto-timeout.
steps: Connect PIR sensor OUT pin to Arduino Pin 4 and power from 5V rail
Wire relay module control pin to Arduino Pin 8 to switch lamp circuit
Implement non-blocking software timer to keep light active for 15 seconds after last motion
Add LDR light sensor override so lighting only triggers during dark hours
